events.title: Demo Speedrun Contest!
events.summary: To celebrate Ruffed Up being a part of Steam Next Fest, we're holding a speedrun contest! The contest will run from the start of Next Fest (October 19, 2026 10:00AM PDT) to the end of the month (October 31, 2026 11:59PM PDT), so start assembling a team of your fastest pups and practicing your rescue boosts! events.title: Ruffed Up Demo Patch Notes - 2026/10/08
events.summary: Hello all! In preparation for the upcoming Steam Next Fest, we've updated our demo build with some new content! Please check it out!New Features/ContentAdded walker customizationWalker skintone, hair color, hairstyle, hat and outfit can be customized by interacting with the walker in the lobbyAdded unlockable dog customization optionsNew sections have been added to Park New sections have been added to CitySections in Factory have been re-arranged Bug FixesFixed issues related to controller input

events.title: Demo Update Incoming!
events.summary: Hello everyone! We're pleased to announce that we'll soon be updating the Ruffed Up Demo in preparation for the upcoming October Steam Next Fest! In the meantime, here's a sneak peek of some of the new features we've been working on… With this new demo build, we're also looking to hold a speedrun contest in the Discord for the chance to win free game keys! Join our Discord here in order to stay updated on the format of the contest. Happy barking!

events.title: Demo Patch Notes 8/16/2026
events.summary: Hello everyone! Thank you so much for playing the Ruffed Up demo. We're happy to announce we've hit 12,000+ wishlists! We couldn't have done this without your support.This demo update comes with a hotly-requested new feature - Photo Mode! Feel free to tag us when posting on social media, or join our Discord and share your pics there! We're looking forward to seeing the creative images you guys will undoubtedly make.Demo Patch Notes 8/16/2026New FeaturesAdded Photo Mode to the gameAdded Vietnames
